title: Animate Plugin Residual Mop-Up (TS Renderer)
description: Fold 🎞️animate's leftover TS residual (the present/renderer/react implementation, @semio-tech/animate-present-renderer-react, ~11k lines single-file React renderer at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/🎛️apps/🎬️present/📺️renderer/⚛️react/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript) into Shape V2: create ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/ (manifests + entry index.ts only) and relocate the actual component source to the owner tree at 🎛️apps/🎬️present/📺️renderer/⚛️react/🟦️component.tsx (single file, no splitting — that's a separately-ticketed follow-up per the spicy-umbrella plan). Update root package.json workspaces, repoint any external references to the old package name if renamed, delete the old ⚡️implementations sandwich once verified (bun install, typecheck, vitest). Scope: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/** only (plus the minimal necessary repoints in root package.json, .storybook/scopes.ts, and ♻️mit-bestand's projektetage app which depends on this package by name).
summary:
Folded 🎞️animate's leftover TS residual (@semio-tech/animate-present-renderer-react, ~11k-line single-file React renderer) into Shape V2. Created ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/ (package.json renamed to @semio-tech/animate-js, 📋️project.json with all 4 leveled test targets, 📜️script.ts, 🧪️vitest.config.ts, 🟦️vitest.setup.ts, 📦️index.ts wiring-only entry that `export *`s from the domain-tree component). Relocated the real source into the owner tree as a plain component file: 🎛️apps/🎬️present/📺️renderer/⚛️react/🟦️component.tsx (byte-identical move, diff-verified) with its sibling 🎨️globals.css (kept alongside since the component does runtime `readFileSync`/`import.meta.url`-relative lookups of it). Deleted the old ⚡️implementations sandwich.

Renamed the npm package (animate-present-renderer-react → animate-js, matching the plan's `<plugin>-js` convention) and repointed every external reference found via repo-wide grep: root package.json workspaces array (+ removed the already-dangling, unrelated `🎬️present/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript` puzzle... no animate-present-core entry — left untouched, see below), .storybook/scopes.ts animate scope sourceRoot, .storybook/globals.css and mit-bestand's own globals.css `@source`/`@import` paths, .storybook/stories/animate/PresentationDeck.stories.tsx (import + globals.css subpath import), root 🧪️vitest.config.ts's KNOWN_BROKEN_IN_AGGREGATOR map entry, and ♻️mit-bestand/🎤️präsentation/📅️33.projektetage's package.json/⚙️vite.config.ts/🧪️vitest.config.ts/📦️index.ts (dependency name + dynamic import). Also removed 4 already-stale puzzle-rust workspace entries and confirmed root package.json is valid JSON.

Verification: `bun nx show project @semio-tech/animate-js` resolves correctly with all 4 test targets and correct packageExports; the old project name is gone from nx. `bun ./📜️script.ts test` from the new package dir (the real wired nx target) runs vitest, correctly collects the relocated component.tsx, and fails ONLY on `Cannot find module '@semio-tech/animate-present-core'` — a pre-existing, already-tracked bug (root 🧪️vitest.config.ts's own KNOWN_BROKEN_IN_AGGREGATOR comment, ticket 26/08/05/STALE-CONFIG-FIXES-AND-CAPABILITY-LINT-REVIVAL, predates this ticket: the package that defines `@semio-tech/animate-present-core` does not exist anywhere in the repo despite two real dependents importing real types/functions from it). This is NOT introduced by this move — the OLD vitest.config.ts had the identical broken alias before I touched anything. `bun install` still errors repo-wide on 2 entries: the pre-existing animate-present-core one (untouched, out of scope) and an unrelated flow-plugin bim-extension wasm pkg path (another concurrent session's in-flight W6 TS pilot work) — neither is caused by or fixable within this ticket's scope. Repo-wide grep confirms zero remaining references to the old package name or old path anywhere outside historical ticket records.
